unseen_source.selection_rule: Use exactly the pulse returned by the NIST v2 next-pulse endpoint for target_unix_ms. Record pulse.uri, pulse.timeStamp, pulse.outputValue, pulse.signatureValue, chainIndex and pulseIndex before generating cases.

transport.challenge: Future-beacon-derived finite IEEE754 values including one subnormal, nested transport, canonical dictionary order and checksum tamper rejection.
transport.oracle: Exact little-endian f64 bits and lossless hash identity.

graph.challenge: Connected cyclic resistive graph plus generated floating-component negative control and insertion-order permutation.
graph.oracle: Independent Python Fraction nodal solve for potentials, edge currents and port currents; KCL/power residual checks.

mechanics.challenge: Generated non-axis-aligned 1D geometry using exact Pythagorean unit axes, randomized masses/stiffness/damping, endpoint/id reversal and DAE mass-floor negative control.
mechanics.oracle: Independent Python Fraction stiffness solve for displacement-per-newton.

events.challenge: Future-beacon-selected quartic with two simple roots plus one double/tangent root on an exact 1/16 grid, delimiter-rich element id, randomized sign and malformed-sign negative control.
events.oracle: Exact rational polynomial construction and predeclared clustered-root tolerance.

reveal_protocol.before_target_time: Do not fetch or materialize the selected future pulse/cases.
after_target_time: Fetch the exact selection_endpoint response and archive the raw pulse JSON.
Verify pulse.statusCode == 0, pulse.version == 2.0, 128-hex outputValue and pulse time is at/after target.
Run the frozen generator exactly once on pulse.outputValue and record generated case JSON SHA256.
Do not edit generator, runner, product, thresholds or expected values after seeing generated cases.
Execute frozen runner on canonical Godot against exact frozen product subject in an independent verifier route.
